key_facts.reason_jp: 株主への利益還元重視、会社業績に応じた適正な利益還元

summary_en: Final dividend for FY5/26 increased by 3 yen to 70 yen/share from 67 yen/share announced on 18 May 2026. Prior-year final dividend was 60 yen/share (52 yen ordinary + 8 yen anniversary commemoration). Subject to approval at regular shareholder meeting in August 2026.
summary_jp: FY5/26期末配当を5月18日公表の67円から70円に増配（3円増）。前期末配当は60円（普通配当52円＋記念配当8円）。8月開催予定の定時株主総会付議予定。
tag_en: Dividend hike – 70 yen/share (3 yen increase) – FY5/26
tag_jp: 配当増配 – 1株当たり70円（3円増配） – 2026年5月期
